A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same research work, with complete, readable main text and appendices A-G. Their text, equations, tables, and figures support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original compression experiments, quantitative and qualitative ablations, a user study, and additional TRELLIS and acceleration experiments in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including Tables 1-3, the user study, and the appendix analyses.

M1.justification: The EMD-based vitality calculation, block-specific pruning, adaptive 4/8-bit quantization, selective fine-tuning, and secondary distillation procedures are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the same Objaverse-based and DALL-E 3 image-to-shape coverage. The appendix figure exchange retains all existing input examples and introduces no additional task or test scenario.

E2.justification: The corresponding comparisons retain Splatter Image, TripoSR, LGM, Craftsman3D, TRELLIS, uncompressed reference models, TinyFusion, and both Diff-Pruning configurations. No comparator is added or removed.

E3.justification: Reported datasets, sample counts, metrics, training budgets, model configurations, and testing procedures are unchanged. Table 1's new Overhead heading reorganizes existing columns without changing the evaluation.

E4.justification: Appendix D.3 revises the model attribution of the qualitative component ablations by exchanging the image grids in Figures F and G under their fixed model captions. This changes the evidence presented for each Hunyuan variant; ablation configurations and all other analyses remain unchanged.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged throughout the tables, plots, and user study. No repeated-run or seed information, uncertainty estimates, or significance procedures are added or revised.

E6.justification: Numerical results are unchanged, but qualitative results change model attribution. The car/multimeter grid moves from Figure G's Hunyuan3D 2mini caption to Figure F's Hunyuan3D 2.0 caption; the headphone-character/pen grid moves oppositely. These are reassigned existing outputs, not newly demonstrated performance gains.

T1.justification: The vitality definition and permutation constraints in Equation 1, distillation objective in Equation 2, and mathematical reasoning are unchanged. No theorem, proof, or formal assumption is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same novelty claim, compression contributions, up-to-66% model-size reduction claim, and preservation-of-quality claim.

C2.justification: Interpretations of layer importance, compression behavior, and geometry-versus-appearance sensitivity are unchanged. Appendix G retains the same limitations concerning inherited geometric failures, extreme quantization, and manually selected thresholds.

D1.justification: Section 4 and Appendix A retain the same thresholds, target-layer indices, learning rates, training durations, batch sizes, and hardware information. No code or data access information changes.

R1.justification: The 60 references and the discussion positioning the work relative to 3D generation, diffusion compression, and layer-vitality research are unchanged.

P1.justification: The arXiv version/date stamp changes. Body wording and section organization are otherwise retained, with appendix text reflowing around figures rather than being substantively rewritten.

P2.justification: Table 1 adds an Overhead group heading. Figures F and G exchange image grids while retaining their captions, and Figure H moves upward on page 30, causing subsequent appendix text to reflow. These are localized presentation changes.

improvement.justification: The revised Figures F/G attribution aligns better with Table 2 and Figure 8, which show greater random-pruning damage for Hunyuan3D 2.0 than for 2mini. Table 1's Overhead heading also improves clarity. These limited corrections improve internal consistency and presentation while leaving the scientific methods and numerical evidence unchanged.
